description: This file defines a React component for a sales order page, allowing users with specific roles to create new orders by entering customer ID and order items, then submitting the form. It manages form state, handles form submission via an API client, and renders a user interface with validation and feedback messages.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates a specific field of an order item in the component's state.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Handles the submission of the sales order form, makes an API request to create the order, and updates UI state based on success or failure.
